## Description {#details}

<p>Selects the graphics adapter used while initializing a C API session.</p>


<p>Chain this extension from <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qaronboardinit">QarOnboardInit</a> or <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarrejoininit">QarRejoinInit</a>. The session's Vulkan and D3D11 devices, and with them every render sender's frame textures, are created on this adapter; absent, the library picks one. Windows accepts a LUID; other platforms accept a UUID. The C API currently supports NVIDIA adapters only.</p>
